data.subject: Course Withdrawal Deadline and Process
data.body: For the 2026–2027 academic year, submit your course withdrawal request through the student services portal while the withdrawal period is open.[RH-2026-101:seed:1] The deadline is 5:00 p.m. on Friday of the eighth teaching week; the system does not accept requests submitted after that time.[RH-2026-101:seed:4]
